capabilities: Embed AI chat services (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) in a sidebar
Send selected editor text directly into the active chat
Build and inject vault context from notes, open tabs, or folders
Save AI responses from the clipboard into the vault
Add custom AI tools by URL and keep two services visible in a split view
disambiguation: Not an API-based AI assistant; it embeds AI chat websites in a webview sidebar rather than calling model APIs.
extras: Installation, settings, and architecture documentation lives in separate docs files referenced from the README. The plugin runs entirely locally with no backend or telemetry, and its manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Using AI chat services with Obsidian means constantly switching to a browser and manually copying notes and responses back and forth.

relations.evidence: Keep ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and your other favorite AI tools inside one seamless Obsidian sidebar.
10 Built-in Services: Switch instantly between ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, Copilot, Manus AI, Kimi, and Ollama

requires.name: accounts with the embedded AI services

summary: Sidebar that embeds AI chat websites like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, and sends vault notes or selected text into them.
